items.name: Media & Entertainment Brand
items.overview: Managed the brand's Facebook and X presence, from planning and scheduling content to reviewing analytics and adjusting the approach based on performance.
responsibilities: Adjusting content approaches based on performance
results: Facebook: about 1M content views and 441K viewers across a 28-day window (Meta analytics).
X: 605.1K impressions and 8.2K engagements over 14 Sep to 10 Oct (X Analytics).
